research_question: Using the exact same five cutoff-safe component signals as the existing consensus candidate ranker, does equal-weight Borda rank aggregation improve candidate_recall@K and downstream three-line portfolio outcomes without changing the allocator?
novelty_statement: This is a single fixed rank-aggregation ablation, not a feature search. Existing candidate_recall_v1.py uses the arithmetic mean of five z-scored signals. E080 replaces only that aggregation rule with the sum of component rank positions. It adds no signal, parameter grid, weights, thresholds, or allocator variant.

prior_work_boundary.E059: E054 candidate-recall decomposition; not rank aggregation.
prior_work_boundary.E072: Five-bin probability calibration of the existing consensus score; proper scoring rules, not rank aggregation.
prior_work_boundary.E074: Calendar-month conditioned frequency model with fixed top-18 partition; different candidate feature family.
prior_work_boundary.E079: Fixed E054 candidate bank and allocator structural-objective ablation; not candidate rank aggregation.
prior_work_boundary.no_duplicate_claim: E080 tests the Borda-vs-mean-z aggregation question only; it does not rerun E059/E072/E074/E079 as its main study.

historical_evaluation.cutoff_rule: For each target t, every feature and rank uses only main-number outcomes from rounds <= t-1. The target draw is accessed only after the ranking is frozen for that target.
historical_evaluation.evidence_limit: All targets are historical diagnostics. No result from this study can be called untouched, prospective, or a future confirmation.

candidate_stage.exact_feature_definitions: Use automation/candidate_recall_v1.py::features exactly, including population z-scores, recent30 counts over the prior 30 draws, gap in completed draws since last main-number appearance, momentum=(last10 frequency/10)-(preceding20 frequency/20), balanced=(recent30_z+gap_z)/2, contrarian=(-recent30_z+gap_z)/2. For momentum ranking use the exact integer score 2*count(last10)-count(preceding20) to avoid float tie drift.

Borda_model.formula: For each number n, sum its five component rank positions. Rank ascending by this sum; ties are broken by lower number.
Borda_model.weights: Equal rank weight 1 for each of the five signals.

stable_baseline.formula: Arithmetic mean of the same five component z-scores; descending score, then lower number.

candidate_stage.metric: candidate_recall@K = mean over targets of (winning main numbers among top K / 6).
candidate_stage.random_baseline: Exact uniform K-subset expectation: expected hits=6*K/45 and recall=K/45. Additionally generate 200 target-matched random K-subsets per target using a preregistered deterministic Fisher-Yates permutation schedule.
candidate_stage.miss_trace: For each of six winning numbers per target, store Borda rank, consensus rank, and five component ranks so excluded winners can be attributed to component-rank disagreement. Do not publish candidate lists or top-30 numbers.

inference.comparisons_definition: Borda vs exact uniform and consensus vs exact uniform, for five K values each.
inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target recall differences; block length 50; 17 blocks sampled with replacement; each valid contiguous start is equally likely.
inference.Borda_minus_consensus: Descriptive paired point differences only; no separate confidence interval or promotion test.

portfolio_stage.allocator: Fixed top-18 rank partition: ranks 1-6, 7-12, 13-18 become exactly three six-number lines. No allocator changes or tuning.

exact_geometry_matched_null.geometry: Three disjoint six-number tickets with union18.

portfolio_stage.matched_random: 120 uniformly random label permutations per target, applied jointly to the fixed three-line geometry; 102,000 bundles total.

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched null; block length 50; every valid contiguous block start equally likely.
inference.nonoverlapping_block_stability: 17 consecutive 50-target blocks; report any2-positive block share; minimum 0.65.
